Chapter 07 of 19

The Probes

Check The EdgePort / Burrard Inlet110 BPM
The story

Down at the port, giant cranes stand along the water. Most people think they are for lifting containers. In Terminal City they are the Probes: sensory instruments, like enormous antennas, and their job is to find out what is happening in the world beyond the fog.

The Probes send ships out of the city carrying questions. When the ships come back, the cranes lift something more than cargo. They lift weather, rumours, objects, languages, sounds and other kinds of news. Sometimes the cargo is only the box the information travelled in.

Anything the city cannot understand is sent across the water to the Far Shore to be translated. Anything useful is broadcast through the Wire Choir. And if you ever see a crane turned to face inland instead of the sea, you will know it has learned something. Send out. Bring back. Lift the signal. What did you see?

Terminal City is an original fictional mythology inspired by Vancouver’s geography, weather, wildlife, infrastructure, art, and electronic music. It makes no claim to historical, Indigenous, or religious tradition. Real places are used as settings; the operating system layered on them is invented. Photograph reality. Alter the evidence. Never illustrate the whole myth.
